title: Why do you lift more when you shout? 🗣️
caption:
In a 1961 study people got stronger when they shouted just before pulling, and later studies found the same with a short shout or grunt. Scientists think it fires more muscle at once. Gym grunters, this one is for you 👇

Why Does This Happen? #15
sources: Ikai M, Steinhaus AH. Some factors modifying the expression of human strength. J Appl Physiol 1961;16:157-163
Welch AS, Tschampl M. Something to shout about: a simple, quick performance enhancement technique improved strength in both experts and novices. J Appl Sport Psychol 2012;24:418-428
O'Connell DG et al. The effects of 'grunting' on serve and forehand velocities in collegiate tennis players. J Strength Cond Res 2014;28:3469-3475
